A member of [[Darth Krayt]]'s [[One Sith|New Sith Order]], this '''[[Dashade/Legends|Dashade]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]''' was part of a [[First Sith Imperial Strikeforce|strikeforce]] sent by [[Regent/Legends|Regent]] [[Morlish Veed]] to capture [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]] during the execution of [[Operation: Thunderstroke]] on the planet [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]].<ref name="Legacy 2006 46">[[Legacy (2006) 46|''Legacy'' (2006) 46]]</ref>
